tuning_data: IMS Test 1 only (first channel per bearing)

bearing.name: Rexnord ZA-2115 (IMS rig)
bearing.source: Qiu, Lee & Lin (2006), J. Sound Vib. 289:1066-1090

selection_rule: smallest theta with every undamaged bearing ALERT fraction <= 0.01

post_hoc_changes.change: Readings are processed in timestamp order, not archive order
post_hoc_changes.why: Test 3's archive stores 2004.04.18.02.42.55 between 04.04.19.01.57 and 04.04.19.11.57; v1.0 analysed it mid-run

post_hoc_changes.change: A reading whose RMS is below 10% of the bearing's normal RMS gets no verdict (DATA_INSUFFICIENT)
post_hoc_changes.why: The last readings of Tests 2 and 3 are flat on all channels (2-4% of normal RMS): the rig had stopped. v1.0 scored them as valid

post_hoc_note: Both changes were made after the v1.0 held-out results were seen. v1.0 results are preserved in results/v1.0_preregistered/.
